models.name: Qwen3.5 4B
models.why: A native vLLM + ROCm 7.15 runtime for AMD RX 6000 cards on Windows 11 (no WSL2, custom rocBLAS built via TheRock) reached up to 62 tokens per second with Qwen3.5-4B on an RX 6750 XT, and runs on RX 6600 through 6750 XT with 8 GB of free storage.

engines.hardware: RX 6750 XT 12GB, Windows 11 23H2, native vLLM + ROCm 7.15 (TheRock rocBLAS, no WSL2)
